problem: The company wanted to charge for API access.
title: Twitter ends free API access and introduces paid tiers
context: Twitter's API was free for many developers, researchers and bot makers.
decision_made: End free API access and offer paid tiers, including a $100 per month basic tier.
action_taken: Announced in Feb 2023; the timeline shifted several times and free access was gone by April.
observed_outcome: Developers and researchers reacted strongly; some said they would shut down apps or bots. Revenue effects were not established by the sources used.
lessons: Removing a free tier abruptly can break a dependent ecosystem even if some users pay.
limitations: Reaction is documented; long-term business results are not. The company had unusual circumstances in 2023.

claims.claim_text: Twitter announced it would end free API access and offer paid tiers.
Developers and researchers criticised the change and some said they would shut down projects.
